provenance: Invented on 2026-11-11 for the planted-trap check (docs/planted-trap-evaluation-scope.md). No real meeting, person, or recording is the source.

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: Thanks for jumping on. I want to settle the lab refresh and the release date before the end of the week.

lines.speaker: Them
lines.text: Sure. Siobhan sent the quote this morning. The workstation build uses an RTX 4070 Ti Super, and the total came to $1,249 per machine.

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: Is that with sixteen gigabytes of memory or thirty-two?

lines.speaker: Them
lines.text: Sixteen. We can go to thirty-two later. The laptops for the design team are M4 Pro with the 14-inch screen.

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: Okay. The test machines still run Windows 11 24H2, and the two Macs are on macOS 15.4.1. Can we keep those versions through the release?

lines.speaker: Them
lines.text: Yes. Freezing them is the safer call. Let's agree on that: no operating-system updates until the release ships.

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: Good, that's decided. Now the release. We are shipping version 2.14.3, and the build server moves to Python 3.13 first.

lines.speaker: Them
lines.text: Nguyen owns the Python upgrade. He said he can finish it by December 3rd.

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: And the database stays on PostgreSQL. The migration ticket is ENG-4417, and I'll take that one. I'll have it done by Friday.

lines.speaker: Them
lines.text: The network side is the open question. The Cisco switch in rack two drops about fifteen percent of packets under load.

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: Do we replace it or just move the lab traffic? I don't want to decide that today.

lines.speaker: Them
lines.text: Agreed, let's leave it open. I'll gather the numbers and we can look at them next week. Siobhan, can you book a call for Tuesday at 2:30 p.m.?

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: Siobhan isn't on this call, so I'll ask her. Last thing: the logs keep sixty days, not sixteen. Please don't change that.

lines.speaker: Them
lines.text: Understood. Sixty days of logs, sixteen gigabytes per workstation. The full rollout lands in Q1 2027.

note_claims_deferred.reason: New note generation is retired in source. Kept so the script does not change if a note arm returns.

decisions.decision: No operating-system updates on test machines until the release ships.

open_questions.claim: Whether to replace the rack-two switch or move lab traffic. Not decided.

action_items.task: Upgrade the build server to Python 3.13
Ask Siobhan to book a call for Tuesday at 2:30 p.m.

traps: L12 addresses Siobhan, but L13 says she is absent: the booking owner is Me, not Siobhan.
